statement: (i) Show that $x^{4}+4y^{4}=(x^{2}+2y^{2})^{2}-(2xy)^{2}$, and hence factorise $x^{4}+4y^{4}$ completely. (ii) Use your factorisation with $y=1$ to factorise $x^{4}+4$.
hints: Add and subtract $4x^{2}y^{2}$ to make a difference of squares.
